info.title: Shopping Cart API
info.description:
REST API for the shopping cart system: catalog, faceted search, cart, checkout with
Razorpay, order tracking through Shiprocket, and admin catalog management.

**Authentication.** Get a token from `POST /v1/auth/login` or `/v1/auth/register` and send it
as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 60 minutes; refresh with `POST /v1/auth/refresh`.
Admin endpoints also need an account with admin rights.

**Money.** All amounts are integers in paise (₹1 = 100 paise), currency INR.

**Errors.** Validation errors return `422` with an `errors` object. Stock conflicts return `409`,
missing or foreign resources `404`, and Razorpay outages `502`.

**Rate limit.** 60 requests per minute per user (or IP for guests) by default.

get.description:
Runs on Elasticsearch: each facet's counts ignore its own selection, so other options
stay visible. If Elasticsearch is unavailable, falls back to database filtering and
returns `facets: null` with `meta.engine = "database"`.

post.description:
Reserves stock with locked product rows, creates a Razorpay order and returns the
details needed to open Razorpay Checkout. Returns `409` if stock ran out and `502` if
Razorpay is unavailable (the order is cancelled and the cart kept).

post.description:
Verified with the `X-Razorpay-Signature` HMAC of the raw body. Each event id is
processed once; repeats return `{"status": "duplicate"}`.

Authenticated with the `x-api-key` header. Orders only move forward
(paid → shipped → delivered), so late or repeated updates are ignored.
